verdict.rationale: Unstructured can be driven headlessly through its Python SDK and REST endpoints, callable from cURL or standard clients. Job APIs let you trigger runs, monitor status, download results and inspect failed files, and workflow APIs let you create, update, run and delete workflows programmatically. Together these give the non-interactive control that automation needs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), a documented standalone CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
